LADANG BUKIT SEROK - FACT PACK (B.S. Oil Palm Sdn Bhd, Far East Holdings Berhad group). Deputy COO / Plantation Controller En. Nazaruddin Bin Hasim. Estate Manager En. Mohd Hamizan Bin Samsudin. Crop goes to Kosfarm Palm Oil Mill.

SOURCES. (1) PA Report 1/2026 (Planting Advisory), visit 16 March 2026, reviewing January-December 2025 and January-February 2026, Planting Advisor En. Adnan Bin Mustafa (previous PA visit 29 October 2025 by Tuan Haji Abdullah Bin Busu Hanifah, PA 2/2025, Jan-Sep 2025). (2) Agronomy Report 2/2026, visit 29 July 2026, Senior Agronomist Mr. Chong Kuan Ming; holds the 2027 fertiliser programme. (3) Agronomy Report 1/2026, visit 4 February 2026 (Chong Kuan Ming and Junior Agronomist En. Muhammad Ghazali Bin Abdul Ghani), 2026 programme unamended. Earlier: Agro 2/2025 (20 Aug 2025, 2026 programme first issued) and Agro 1/2025 (5 Feb 2025, amended 2025 programme).

AREA (PA, Feb 2026). B.S. Oil Palm Sdn Bhd mature 2,058.80 ha (91.18%); FEHB Division TR04J 167.57 ha (7.42%) excluded from the B.S. planted area but managed by the estate; total planted 2,226.37 ha, all mature; buildings 8.70 ha; unplantable 22.90 ha; title 2,257.93 ha. Fields (ha, stand/ha PA): P01A 340.03 (135), P02B 321.69 (131), P07K 197.14 (130), P08L 199.60 (135), P09C 194.45 (134), P10D 185.79 (131), P10F 90.31 (136), P10G 208.56 (143), P11H 144.10 (146), P12M 29.43 (143), P14E 147.70 (141), TR04J 167.57 (140). Planted 2001 (A) to 2014 (E). About 63% prime age (11-18 yr), 37% over 20 years. Replanting (Agro 2/2026, revised): P01A4/A5 159.41 ha 2028, A1-A3 180.62 ha 2029, P02B3-5 162.40 ha 2030, B1-B2 159.29 ha 2031, P04J 167.57 ha 2032, P07K 197.14 ha 2033. PA still shows 2027 and 2028 for P01A.

CROP. PA 2025 (B.S. area): 51,727.96 t vs budget 45,000 t (115%), 25.13 t/ha vs 21.86; CPO 9,936.92 t, OER 19.21%, KER 5.00%, CPO 4.83 t/ha. PA Jan-Feb 2026: 7,573.90 t vs budget 5,337 t (142%), 3.68 t/ha vs 2.59; same period 2025 4,675.84 t (2.27 t/ha); 2026 annual budget 46,400 t. Agro whole estate (2,226.40 ha): 2021 37,164.32 t (16.69 t/ha), 2022 48,646.84 (21.85), 2023 40,378.80 (18.14), 2024 60,423.24 (27.14), 2025 55,418.96 (24.89). 2026 monthly: Jan 4,871.90, Feb 3,218.60, Mar 3,185.08, Apr 3,761.68, May 3,226.32, Jun 3,559.52 t; 1st half 21,823.10 t, 9.80 t/ha vs 22,651.34 t, 10.17 in 2025 (-3.6%). Field Jan-Jun 2026 t/ha (2025): 01A 8.82 (9.20), 02B 9.40 (7.70), TR04J 8.34 (9.03), 07K 9.29 (9.74), 08L 9.74 (10.05), 09C 11.53 (12.74), 10D 10.33 (9.26), 10F 8.62 (10.35), 10G 10.50 (11.69), 11H 12.14 (12.60), 12M 11.58 (12.09), 14E 9.55 (12.60). Field 2025 t/ha (2024): 01A 21.04 (22.22), 02B 21.59 (22.41), TR04J 22.02 (24.69), 07K 22.62 (26.43), 08L 24.68 (30.38), 09C 29.57 (32.45), 10D 22.98 (27.25), 10F 27.37 (30.69), 10G 29.96 (30.65), 11H 30.99 (31.72), 12M 29.6 (31.73), 14E 28.21 (28.38). Declines blamed on seasonal pattern and climate; P10F, P10G, P14E below expectation in 2026. Harvesting rounds 24.03 average in 2025 (100.12%), 12.0 to Jun 2026 (100%).

COST (PA, Jan-Dec 2025, RM per t FFB). General charges 57.69 (budget 72.48), upkeep & cultivation 85.46 (111.65), harvesting & collection 73.87 (78.39); ex-estate 217.02 vs 262.52 (-17%). Processing 70.00, palm oil transport 7.53, cess 3.07, windfall tax 31.36 (budget 16.50), depreciation 4.68, amortisation 36.16; grand total 481.78. General charges RM3,141,010 = RM1,525.65/ha vs RM1,685.38 (-9%); overspends: exec travel +21% (RM907), labour EPF +16% (55 new workers), medical VMO (RM34,476 over), recruitment (RM120,125 over). Upkeep RM/ha: weeding 206.47 (230.44), manuring 1,591.92 (1,671.02; material 1,395.85, EFB mulching 64.69 vs 38.86), P&D 59.76 (100.38), census 1.05 (14.96), drains 29.77 (70.05), roads 125.58 (179.01), soil/water 1.34 (15.18), boundaries 11.26 (14.63), pruning 119.66 (140.63), soil & foliar 0.44 (4.00); total 2,147.25 (2,440.30). Contract harvesting RM47.12/t, internal transport RM26.75/t.

LABOUR (PA, Feb 2026). 161 workers (22 checkroll, 139 contract) vs 164 required; 1 worker per 14 ha. Harvesters 83/83, infield collectors 20/20, internal transport 21/21, weeding 9/12 (short 3), manuring 10/12, mandore 7/7. 103 harvesters and collectors = 1 per 22 ha. Contractors: Nusantara Plantation 1,400.91 ha with 78 harvesters, Sky Kayla Enterprise 825.46 ha with 30 (also works Kampung Aur). Many staff transfers Nov 2025-Jan 2026 (new Senior Assistant Manager Sa'aban Bin Tugiman, Account Executive Zulpikah, two supervisors). Harvester productivity Feb 2026 1.50 (P10D) to 2.75 (P11H) t/man-day; rates RM31.50-36.50/t; earnings RM48.75-87.04/day. Mechanisation: 13 mini crawlers (5.97 t/day, 1.96 t/harvester) and 7 Timac Badang (10.14, 2.34). Intervals 14-17 days Jan-Feb 2026; in Jun 2026 48% of fields at 16-20 days.

MANURING. 2025 fully applied, 3,038.90 t (Mix A 435.70, Mix B 1,281.05, RP 337.30, AS 74.55, NK1 910.30). Feb 2026: 352.20 of 705.80 t (50%). Jun 2026: H1 programme 1,526.80 t all applied, but over a month late for several rounds (NK1 and Mix C delivered late). 2026 programme (grams/palm): P01A1-A3 NK 2,500 x2; P02B NK1 2,250, 2,250, 2,000 (B2 1,750); TR04J Mix C/NK1 2,000 x4; P07K Mix C 2,000, Mix B 2,000, RP 1,500, Mix C 2,000, Mix B 2,000; P08L/P09C Mix C 2,500, Mix B 2,250, RP 1,500, Mix C 2,500, Mix B 2,250; P10G/H/M/E KIE or AS 1,000, Mix B 2,250 x4, RP 1,500-1,750. 2027 programme (Agro 2/2026) adds kieserite 750 g in many blocks, P01A NK1 2,500 x2 (A4/A5 withdrawn), P02B Mix A then NK1 at 2,250-2,500. EFB: P02B2 4,258 t on 85.17 ha in H1 2026 (about 50 t/ha) but uneven and heaped; in 2025 14,487.34 t on B2 (3 rounds). EFB should go to sandy and lateritic soils.

LEAF. Mean N/P/K/Mg/Ca/B: 2024 2.56/0.161/0.97/0.30/0.65/14.49; 2025 2.63/0.162/0.95/0.26/0.62/12.82; 2026 (Apr sampling) 2.69/0.165/1.10/0.23/0.63/12.15. Mg remains below range, especially prime areas (H2 0.16, H3 0.18, L2 0.19, C3 0.19). K deficiency signs on sandy soil in P10G. Small palms on laterite in P07K and P14E.

WEEDING. 2025: 3 circle and 3 selective rounds, 100%. 2026 round 1 done all fields by Jun; round 2 about 50%. Circle raking 43% (965.76 ha). Clidemia in B2, F1, K3, G3; Ageratum in circles of B4, J1, K3. VOP and Stenochlaena in low-lying areas need a task force.

PESTS. Rat 2026: Feb/Jun 11-23% (P14E 23%, P08L 21-22%); P08L and P14E baited Jul 2026; 2025 baiting 1,990.26 ha. Barn owls 162 boxes, 143 occupied (88%). Bagworm 2026 census 0-8%, no treatment needed; 2025 Altacor via Bravo 600 and Monocrotophos trunk injection (P01A 102.97 ha, 3 rounds). Ganoderma: P01A 2.1% (2022 census), P02B 1.7%, P10D 1.1% (2024), P10G 0.6%, P11H 0.4%, P12M 0.6% (Jun 2026); deboling ad hoc; no mounding; annual census advised.

PRUNING. 2025 progressive pruning 72% (8.6 of 12 rounds; P01A 62%, P02B 66%). 2026: corrective pruning in P01A/P02B 30.08 of 661.72 ha (9%) by Feb; by Jun progressive pruning 92% of fields, P01A/P02B 73% with about 180 ha outstanding; supertall palms in P01; under-pruning in P09C; improper frond stacking in P11H; etiolated palms in P10D terraces.

ROADS AND DRAINS. 2025: 6,706 chains graded, no lateriting; 975 chains of 8x6x4 ft drains desilted. Feb 2026: 143 chains main road graded; 52.36 chains desilted. Desilt P10G, P11H, P12M low areas.

RAINFALL (Agro). 2021 1,898 mm/109 days; 2022 2,270/147; 2023 2,596.5/131; 2024 2,100.5/136; 2025 2,107.5/135; Jan-Jun 2026 741 mm/45 days.

KEY ACTIONS. Clear the P01A/P02B pruning backlog; circle raking; VOP task force; runt thinning; drone and Ganoderma census; post-baiting rat census in P08L and P14E; EFB spread evenly to poor soils; fix fertiliser store and supplier delays; keep harvesting intervals as crop rises; road grading and lateriting early in the year.

limits.t: Pruning backlog in tall P01A, P02B
limits.d: P01A and P02B only 73% of the pruning programme by Jun 2026, about 180 ha outstanding (few skilled tall-palm pruners); excess fronds hamper harvesting.
2026 census 11-23% vs 10% threshold; P14E 23% and P08L 21-22% (Feb/Jun 2026). P01A and P02B not baited in 2025-2026.

limits.t: Old, tall palms in P01A and P02B
limits.d: 37% of area over 20 years old. P01A 21.04 t/ha in 2025 vs 22.22 in 2024; replanting deferred to 2028/2029.
Leaf Mg below range, mean 0.23 (Apr 2026), worst in prime areas: H2 0.16, H3 0.18, L2 0.19, C3 0.19. Possible K deficiency on sandy soil in P10G.
48% of fields at 16-20 days in Jun 2026; over-ripe bunches in P10G3 and P02B5.

pa.d: Corrective pruning in P01A/P02B 30.08 of 661.72 ha (9%) by Feb 2026; 2025 progressive pruning only 72% (8.6 of 12 rounds).
Feb 2026: circle spraying 14%, selective 20%. VOP and Stenochlaena in low-lying areas need a task force; runt thinning not done.
Harvesters at 1.50 t/man-day in P10D and 1.69 in P07K (Feb 2026); mini crawlers 5.97 t/machine-day.
2025: 6,706 chains graded but no lateriting. PA wants grading and lateriting by Q2 and desilting of low-lying P10G, P11H and P12M.
